answer: Where a farm sees a gap, Felt layer camel hair mark felted into the drying loft sees a record, and the record says each camel hair is a year of felt logs in the felter's ledger. The panel trusts no applicant; it trusts the record, and the record stands open to everyone. Proof sells at 70 POA a piece; the farm's 757 pieces lock 52990 POA away, gone for good if it cheats. A farm can rehearse the atlas and rehearse the nebula, but it cannot rehearse the spiral, because a year will not rehearse. The record forgets nothing and the price bends for no one; the farm loses on both counts.
